                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'type QueryConfig = Omit<Query, "kind" | "fn">;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Creates an {@link Action} definition.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Actions are server-side write operations. Like queries, they can be\n'[39m +

                    [32m' * @param config\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * @category Constructors\n'[39m +

                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Creates an {@link Api} endpoint definition.\n'[39m +

                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +

                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +

                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * See the [Auth overview](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/overview) for the\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * supported auth methods and how the `User` entity is connected to auth.\n'[39m +

                    [32m' * in their input. Hook return values are ignored except for\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * {@link AuthHooks.onBeforeOAuthRedirect}, which can change the redirect URL.\n'[39m +

                    [32m'export interface Auth extends AuthHooks {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Name of the Prisma model that represents the application user connected to\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * your business logic.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * The user entity needs to have an ID field that uniquely identifies each\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * user. It can be of any name and type, but it needs to be marked with `@id`:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * ```prisma title="schema.prisma"\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * model User {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *   id Int @id @default(autoincrement())\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * ```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +

                    [32m'     * define them in the `userSignupFields` field if they need to be set during\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * the sign-up process.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * See [Accessing User Data](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/entities) for how the\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * user entity connects to the rest of the auth system.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    userEntity: EntityName;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /** Enabled authentication methods. */\n'[39m +

                  [32m'        FOR UPDATE\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      `;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (!products || products.length === 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        throw new HttpError(404, `Product not found: ID ${item.productId}`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const product = products[0];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (product.inventory < item.quantity) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        throw new HttpError(400, "Insufficient inventory");\n'[39m +

                  [32m'        quantity: item.quantity,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        price: itemPrice,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // Apply coupon if provided\n'[39m +

                  [32m'        throw new HttpError(400, "Invalid coupon code");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (coupon.type === "PERCENTAGE") {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        discount = subtotal * (coupon.value / 100);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      } else if (coupon.type === "FLAT") {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        discount = coupon.value;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (discount > subtotal) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        discount = subtotal;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const total = subtotal - discount;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // Create the order\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const newOrder = await tx.order.create({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      data: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        subtotal,\n'[39m +

                  [32m'        },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    return newOrder;\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  \n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const [couponMessage, setCouponMessage] = useState<{ text: string; isError: boolean } | null>(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const [checkoutMessage, setCheckoutMessage] = useState<{ text: string; isError: boolean } | null>(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleAddToCart = (product: Product) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setCart((prev) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const currentQty = prev[product.id] || 0;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        ...prev,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        [product.id]: currentQty + 1,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleRemoveFromCart = (productId: number) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setCart((prev) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const newCart = { ...prev };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      delete newCart[productId];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return newCart;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const updateQuantity = (productId: number, qty: number) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (qty <= 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      handleRemoveFromCart(productId);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setCart((prev) => ({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      ...prev,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      [productId]: qty,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }));\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleApplyCoupon = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    e.preventDefault();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setCouponMessage(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (!couponCode.trim()) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCouponMessage({ text: "Please enter a coupon code", isError: true });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const coupon = await applyCoupon({ code: couponCode.trim() });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setAppliedCoupon(coupon);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCouponMessage({ text: "Coupon applied successfully!", isError: false });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } catch (err: any) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setAppliedCoupon(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const errMsg = err.message || "Invalid coupon code";\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCouponMessage({ text: errMsg, isError: true });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleCheckout = async () => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setCheckoutMessage(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setIsSubmitting(true);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const cartItems = Object.entries(cart)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      .filter(([_, qty]) => qty > 0)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      .map(([id, qty]) => ({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        productId: parseInt(id, 10),\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        quantity: qty,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }));\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (cartItems.length === 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCheckoutMessage({ text: "Your cart is empty.", isError: true });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setIsSubmitting(false);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const order = await checkout({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        items: cartItems,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        couponCode: appliedCoupon?.code,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCheckoutMessage({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        text: `Order placed successfully! Order ID: ${order.id}`,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        isError: false,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      // Clear cart and coupon state on success\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCart({});\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCouponCode("");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setAppliedCoupon(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCouponMessage(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } catch (err: any) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const errMsg = err.message || "Checkout failed";\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      // Ensure we display "Insufficient inventory" or "Out of stock" clearly on inventory failure\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCheckoutMessage({ text: errMsg, isError: true });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } finally {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setIsSubmitting(false);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // Calculations\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const cartItemsList = products\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    ? Object.entries(cart)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        .map(([id, qty]) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          const product = products.find((p: Product) => p.id === parseInt(id, 10));\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          return product ? { product, quantity: qty } : null;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        })\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        .filter((item): item is { product: Product; quantity: number } => item !== null)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    : [];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const subtotal = cartItemsList.reduce((acc, item) => acc + item.product.price * item.quantity, 0);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let discount = 0;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (appliedCoupon) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (appliedCoupon.type === "PERCENTAGE") {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      discount = subtotal * (appliedCoupon.value / 100);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } else if (appliedCoupon.type === "FLAT") {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      discount = appliedCoupon.value;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (discount > subtotal) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      discount = subtotal;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const total = subtotal - discount;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    <div className="ecommerce-container">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      <header className="header">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        <h1>Wasp E-Commerce Checkout</h1>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      </header>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      {productsError && (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        <div className="error-banner">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          Error loading products: {productsError.message || "Unknown error"}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      )}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      {isLoading ? (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        <div className="loading">Loading products...</div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      ) : (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        <div className="main-layout">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          {/* Product Catalog Section */}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          <section className="catalog-section">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            <h2>Product Catalog</h2>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            <div className="products-grid">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              {products?.map((product: Product) => (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                <div key={product.id} className="product-card">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  <div className="product-info">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                    <h3>{product.name}</h3>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                    <p className="product-price">${product.price.toFixed(2)}</p>\n'[39m +

                  [32m'                      Available Inventory: <strong>{product.inventory}</strong>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                    </p>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  <button\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                    className="add-to-cart-btn"\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                    onClick={() => handleAddToCart(product)}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                    disabled={product.inventory <= 0}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  >\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                    {product.inventory <= 0 ? "Out of Stock" : "Add to Cart"}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  </button>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              ))}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          </section>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          {/* Shopping Cart Section */}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          <section className="cart-section">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            <h2>Your Shopping Cart</h2>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            {cartItemsList.length === 0 ? (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              <p className="empty-cart-text">Your cart is empty. Add some products!</p>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            ) : (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              <div className="cart-container">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                <div className="cart-items-list">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  {cartItemsList.map((item) => (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                    <div key={item.product.id} className="cart-item">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                      <div className="cart-item-details">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                        <h4>{item.product.name}</h4>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                        <p>${item.product.price.toFixed(2)} each</p>\n'[39m +
